name: Verificación de identidad
trigger: The customer asks about their account, balance, debt, overdue payment or payment link, or wants to pay or agree on a payment plan, and their identity has not been verified yet in this conversation.

steps.instruction: Ask for the last four digits of the customer's cédula. A valid answer is four digits.
Ask for the customer's date of birth, including day, month and year.
Send the four cédula digits as digits and the birth date as YYYY-MM-DD, converted from what the customer said.
Thank the customer by first name and tell them their identity is verified, then continue with what they asked for.

fallback.message: No pude verificar tu identidad con esos datos. Por tu seguridad no puedo compartir información de la cuenta. Puedes volver a llamarnos cuando tengas tus datos a la mano. Gracias por llamar.

en.value: I couldn't verify your identity with that information. For your security I can't share any account details. You can call us again when you have your details at hand. Thank you for calling.
